## Overview

This directory contains enterprise standards for IT diagramming tools and conventions. These standards mandate draw.io/diagrams.net and Mermaid as the approved tools for all diagramming work across IT, replacing fragmented use of Visio, Lucidchart, and PowerPoint diagramming features.
